scientific_integrity: A proved exact, infinite-family linear observability rank formula; finite independent checker is corroborative only. No claim of independent historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only cyclic lengths 2^a(2^r-1) with r>=2; one noiseless stationary sensor; integer sampling stride q>=1.
Two relevant 2022 affine/bounded CA observability full texts were inaccessible and may affect historical priority.
Does not treat arbitrary ring lengths or multiple/mobile sensors.
title: Exact sparse-time observability on Mersenne-multiple Rule 60 rings
